elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: "will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: "professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards"
"will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation" — materiality qualifier, not express conformance
"for a period of ninety (90) days following the Company's acceptance"

elements.element: 90-day conformance period for services measured from performance/completion
elements.evidence: period runs "following the Company's acceptance and approval of the Site", not from services performance; no separate services period
"repair or replacement of the non-conforming deliverable"
"a refund of the fees paid to HDI"
"in compliance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations"
"will not contain any virus, worm, disabling device or other malicious code"
"for a period of ninety (90) days following the Company's acceptance and approval of the Site"
no express services conformance period; only the professional/workmanlike standard and the 90-day deliverable period
"repair or replacement of the non-conforming deliverable, or a refund of the fees paid"

reasons: Locked target was preferred, but the inserted warranty gives only a 90-day period tied to acceptance and no 12-month software conformance period, so the preferred bargain is incomplete.
Conformance is qualified by "in all material respects", whereas the preferred position requires express conformance to documentation.
No distinct services warranty period measured from performance/completion is stated, so neither the preferred 90-day services period nor the fallback 30-day services period is expressly satisfied.
Remedy election is given to HDI ("at HDI's option") and adds re-performance, diluting the customer's repair/replace/refund remedy set.

The insertion is otherwise minimal in placement — it adds a missing clause without rewriting Sections 9(a)-(b) — but the qualifiers and vendor-option/re-performance additions go beyond what is needed.
